data.name: Carbon Capture Company
data.description: Carbon Capture Company (CCC) is a Swedish certification body that developed the Carbon Forestry Standard – Sweden, a methodology for certifying and issuing carbon credits from actively managed Swedish forests. It does not physically remove CO2 itself; it acts as certification scheme, runs the certification registry, conducts audits, and issues credits to forest owners, aligning with the EU Carbon Removals and Carbon Farming Regulation.
